read_workspace_fileRead one Python program under .hardwareharness/scripts. Paths start with scripts/ and end with .py.内建展开
write_workspace_fileWrite one Python program under .hardwareharness/scripts. Paths start with scripts/ and end with .py.内建展开

initialize_workspacePrepare the shared project uv environment after saving changes and stopping all Python runs. Packaged defaults install from bundled offline wheels. Set online=true only when intentionally installing additional dependencies from package indexes. Read .hardwareharness/docs/hardwareharness-sdk.md before writing scripts. Hardware occupancy and wiring remain Agent responsibilities; no automatic replay.内建展开
validate_python_fileValidate one Python program under .hardwareharness/scripts with Python syntax checks and Ruff.内建展开

start_python_runStart one saved Python program from .hardwareharness/scripts. The entrypoint must start with scripts/ and end with .py. Hardware operations require existing occupancy; handle wiring and human approval before starting. No automatic replay.内建展开

cancel_python_runcancel python run. Workspace paths are relative to .hardwareharness. Hardware operations require existing occupancy; handle wiring and human approval before starting. No automatic replay.内建展开

get_python_runget python run. Workspace paths are relative to .hardwareharness. Hardware operations require existing occupancy; handle wiring and human approval before starting. No automatic replay.内建展开

list_python_runslist python runs. Workspace paths are relative to .hardwareharness. Hardware operations require existing occupancy; handle wiring and human approval before starting. No automatic replay.内建展开
